why: THREE STATES, AND THE FIRST TWO EXIST FOR UNIT #43's REASON WHILE THE THING
THEY ALL SHARE -- `iStatus = 0` WITH `restart = 0` -- EXISTS FOR A REASON NO
EARLIER UNIT IN THIS CAMPAIGN HAS HAD. The first sweep scored 77 of 89 and
the twelve survivors partition into four places:
the CC_Mode == 2 arm        lines 201, 203        3 survivors
PIController's kp and ki    line 318              2 survivors
the two ErrMsg helpers      lines 119, 146        3 survivors
arguments the callee's own convention discards   4 survivors
The last four are declared equivalent with proofs against the generated
bridge (`mutation/CableControl.equivalences.json`). The states below are
aimed at the first two groups, which are corpus gaps and not equivalences.
WHY THE OPEN-LOOP ARM IS UNREACHED WITHOUT A STATE. It is a conjunction of
four conditions no ladder crosses: `CC_Mode == 2` AND `CC_Group_N >= 1` AND
`Ind_CableControl(I_GROUP) > 0` AND an `OL_CableControl` row whose contents
reach a compared output through `interp1d`. R6 crosses the FOUR quantities
this unit's own predicates test -- CC_Mode, CC_Group_N, aviFAIL and Time --
at the full cross product, so `CC_Mode = 2` with `CC_Group_N = 2` IS
generated; what those cases do not have is a `Ind_CableControl` element at
any particular value, because that subscript is the loop counter and the
generator cannot trace it to a parameter. Identical finding to unit #43's,
one array over.
THE INDEX RAMP IS SPLIT ACROSS TWO STATES BECAUSE THE THREE SURVIVORS AT
THAT ARM NEED THREE DIFFERENT ELEMENT VALUES AT GROUP ONE:
`Ind_CableControl(I) > 0` -> `>= 0`   changes an answer only where the
element is EXACTLY 0
`Ind_CableControl(I) > 0` -> `> 1`    only where it is EXACTLY 1
`I_GROUP = 1` -> `I_GROUP = 2`        only where GROUP ONE is the group
the arm would have interpolated
A single ramp cannot hold 0 and 1 at group one at the same time, so state 1
ramps from 1 (group one interpolates: kills the `> 1` widening and the loop
start) and state 2 ramps from 0 (group one is skipped by the original and
reached by the mutant: kills the `>= 0` widening). Both keep the elements
DISTINCT, which is R5's rule and unit #29's measurement.
`iStatus = 0` AND `restart = 0` TOGETHER, AND THIS IS THE STATE THAT MAKES
THE UNIT'S ARITHMETIC OBSERVABLE AT ALL. `SecLPFilter_Vel` computes its six
filter coefficients ONLY inside `IF ((iStatus == 0) .OR. reset)`
(Filters.f90 at 54dd134). `LocalVar%FP` is a nested type the generator
zero-initialises and does not vary, so on any case with `iStatus /= 0` and
`restart` false the filter divides by `FP%lpfV_a2(inst) = 0.0` and returns
`Inf * 0.0` -- a NaN, which then propagates through `PIController` into
`CC_ActuatedDL`, `CC_ActuatedL` and `avrSWAP`. Measured on the first sweep's
own red test: the no-op's case 0 shows the reference's `CC_ActuatedDL(1)` as
`000000000000f87f`, which is a quiet NaN.
A NaN swallows every coefficient. `PIController`'s `PTerm = kp*error` is NaN
whether kp is 0.0 or 1.0, and `ITerm + DT*ki*error` is NaN whether ki is 1.0
or 2.0 -- which is exactly the two survivors at line 318. And where the
corpus DOES initialise the filter it does so through `restart`, which is the
same value this unit hands `PIController` as its `reset`: a true `restart`
sends `PIController` down the arm that assigns `I0` and reads neither gain.
So the ONE configuration in which either gain can reach an answer is
`iStatus == 0` with `restart` FALSE, and no rung of any ladder crosses those
two names.
`CC_ActTau = 1.0` FOR THE SAME REASON, ONE LEVEL UP. The corner frequency
this unit passes is `2*PI/CC_ActTau`, and `_baseline_state`'s inert fill
would leave `CC_ActTau` at 0.0 -- an infinite corner frequency, which puts
the NaN back by another route. 1.0 gives 6.283 rad/s, and with `DT = 0.01`
the filter's `a2` is 4.25, comfortably finite.
`objInst_instSecLPFV` AND `objInst_instPI` ARE 1, NOT INERT. Both are 1-based
Fortran subscripts into DIMENSION(1024) arrays and the inert fill is 0, which
is a read one element BEFORE two arrays -- undefined in the reference and a
fact about memory layout in the comparison. `harness/ranges.toml` pins both
to 1..1000 for the drawn cases; the state has to state them too.
`CntrPar_CC_GroupIndex` RAMPS 1, 3, 5 -- STEP TWO, WHICH IS THIS UNIT'S OWN
DIFFERENCE FROM #43. Each group writes `avrSWAP` at its index AND at index
+ 1, so a step of one would make group I's second write land on group I+1's
first and the last writer would win. A step of two keeps all six slots
distinct, so both statements of the loop are separately observable.
`OL_Breakpoints` IS STRICTLY INCREASING BECAUSE `interp1d` CHECKS IT. The
callee sets `aviFAIL = -1` and writes a message when its xData is not
strictly increasing, which is an admissible input for the reference but not
an admissible BASELINE: R11's whole property is that exactly one predicate
is away from admissible in each case, and a baseline that entered the error
path would put a second one there in every case built from it.
`LocalVar_Time` IS 1.5, INSIDE THE BREAKPOINTS, so the interpolation runs its
interior arm and every element of the gathered row can reach the answer. Time
is also one of the four knobs, so R11 moves it to 0, 1, 2, 499, 500 and 501
from each state, which puts the `Time > 500` step of the OTHER arm under the
same states' other knob values.
STATE 3 IS THE ERROR PATH AND IT IS SEPARATE FOR R11's OWN REASON: `aviFAIL`
is one of the four knobs, so R11 already moves it to -1 from states 1 and 2 --
but that case then carries the open-loop arm AND the message branch at once,
and a defect in either is attributable to the other. State 3 holds `CC_Mode`
at 0, so the only things it runs are the filter/integrator loop, the avrSWAP
writes and the message.
WHAT THESE STATES DO NOT REACH, stated here rather than left to the score:
the ErrMsg helpers' boundaries -- a supplied length of exactly 1, a supplied
length of 0 or less, and a message whose length equals the staging capacity
exactly. All three are properties of `ErrVar%ErrMsg`'s LENGTH, and
`_baseline_state` deliberately leaves every CHARACTER parameter to R6's own
ladder (`harness/generate.py:1138`), so no state in this file can move them.
They are censused in `evidence/CableControl/mutation.census.txt`, not excused.

states.name: open_loop_three_groups_index_ramp_from_one
states.why: CC_Mode = 2 with CC_Group_N = 3 and Ind_CableControl = 1, 2, 3 takes the open-loop arm at every group -- the only arm in this unit that calls interp1d and the only reader of Ind_CableControl and OL_CableControl. Group one carries EXACTLY 1, which is where `> 0` widened to `> 1` changes an answer and where a loop that started at 2 would skip an interpolation the reference performs. iStatus = 0 with restart = 0 initialises the filter and sends PIController down its integrating arm, so the filter output is finite and both PI gains reach the answer. OL_Breakpoints ramps 0, 1, 2, ... strictly increasing so interp1d raises no error; Time = 1.5 sits between two breakpoints so the interior arm runs. OL_CableControl ramps with a step, so a row gathered from the wrong stride or one element short gives a different interpolant. CC_DesiredL starts at a ramp too, so a group the arm does NOT overwrite is still distinguishable from one it does.

states.name: open_loop_three_groups_index_ramp_from_zero
states.why: The same state with Ind_CableControl = 0, 1, 2. Group one now carries EXACTLY 0, which the reference skips and which `> 0` widened to `>= 0` interpolates -- the one element value that separates them. Group two carries 1, so the `> 1` widening is reachable from this state as well; the two states are not one measurement taken twice, they are the two element values the three survivors at this arm need at DIFFERENT groups.

states.name: error_message_with_no_mode_arm_running
states.why: aviFAIL = -1 with CC_Mode = 0 enters the RoutineName prefix and neither mode arm: the only things that run are the filter/integrator loop, the two avrSWAP writes and the message, so a difference is attributable to those and not to a lookup. CC_Group_N = 3 keeps the loops alive so the state is not a no-op, iStatus = 0 with restart = 0 keeps the filter finite, and the ramps keep every array distinct. The supplied ErrMsg is left to R6's character ladder, which is the one quantity this file cannot state.
